correctness.rationale: For each energy shell E the allowed count of top excitations is the full integer interval max(0,E-n) <= j <= floor(E/2). The negative logarithm of product population relative to ground-only weight is exactly a E+(b-a)j. Necessity/sufficiency of adjacent-shell population ordering under arbitrary unitaries follows by basis-state swaps and doubly stochastic rearrangement. Optimizing the linear cost at shell endpoints and evaluating the two integer maxima gives exactly floor((n-1)/2)|a-b|<=min(a,b). Failure first arises at the stated odd size, for which explicit two-string swaps with energy gap epsilon and higher energy having strictly larger population give positive work. Zero slopes, exact equality, n=1, n=2 and Gibbs states are covered. The standalone exact-integer verifier independently enumerated 2,574 product cases through n=9 and the shell endpoint maxima for 120 sizes; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the fully evaluated necessary-and-sufficient closed-form resource count and parity-staircase boundary for all positive diagonal equally spaced qutrit inputs. The most relevant earlier geometric treatment (arXiv:1912.07968v3, Lemma 7) provides a generic exact ordering algorithm, not the evaluated symbolic formula. The earlier N-passivity bounds (arXiv:1912.02099v4, Proposition 1) are necessary inequalities and Sec. 5 is about N-structural stability; these are explicitly credited. The 2026 motivating channel paper analyzes three-level ergotropic noise and asymptotic work, not the present exact finite first activation number. No search established novelty as a theorem; possible implicit earlier specializations remain a stated risk.
residual_risks: A previously published explicit specialization of the general additive-ensemble k-passivity algorithm may have obtained the same floor formula and odd-only onset but not appeared in the searched indexes.

The necessary three-level inequalities in Salvia–Giovannetti are close to the final criterion; an implicit sufficiency argument elsewhere could reduce originality despite lack of an explicit closed classification.

value.rationale: The first positive-work copy number is a natural operational resource requirement of non-Gibbs passive states and is not merely a free parameter slice. The all-population exact phase diagram resolves all finite sizes at once, yields a non-obvious odd/even resource plateau, quantifies divergence near thermal populations, and gives explicit constructive population-swapping work witnesses. It turns a general exponentially growing finite-spectrum search into a one-line symbolic decision. It makes no claim to determine the maximal ergotropy or the gate cost of implementation.
